**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The LICENSE rule protects us as licensee, but this Agreement contains no inbound licence to IBM — and none is required:

- **§ 13.3(a)** grants *MSL* a royalty-free licence to use IBM confidential information solely to manufacture Products for IBM, and expressly bars any other licence in IBM IP absent a separate signed agreement.
- **EPL §§ 5 and 6** grant *MSL* limited rights to use Loaned Programs and to execute Licensed Internal Code; **§ 12.2** leaves continued licensing to IBM's discretion.
- **Appendix A (p1346)** confirms MSL gets no right or licence in MS Software Images.
- **§§ 13.1–13.2** give IBM outright ownership plus MSL's assignment of all IP in Products and of inventions made on Products and IBM processes — stronger than the rule's preferred licence position.

Targeted searches for "grants IBM", "license to IBM", "royalty-free", and perpetual/irrevocable/revocable/sublicense language surfaced no grant running to our party. Since the only grants here run from us and are restrictive in our favour, broadening them (affiliates/contractors, non-revocability, successor transfer) would work against IBM, so no redline was proposed.
